will_defaults: I will do the work that makes me more valuable, more capable, and more credible.
I will create visible evidence of progress instead of waiting to be discovered.
will_not: I will not confuse wanting advancement with earning readiness.
I will not stay passive and call it patience.
I will not let fear of judgment block necessary action.
reality_anchors: Career growth usually follows visible skill, repeated proof, and strategic consistency.
